status: experimental prototypes supported on this benchmark only

card.goal: Improve a workflow without disclosing potentially sensitive working material.
card.knowledge: Understands local versus hosted processing and the uncertainty of absent data-handling information.
tradeoffs: Accepts extra steps to keep material local
A convenient hosted operation can be unacceptable for this use case
Does not assume a tool is local when the clip is silent about it
stop_conditions: The proposed workflow sends working material to an external service without a suitable alternative
